{"notes": "Visit 5 (ended 7:45). Board: still only the start segment (x~2.5-6.5) is dark. The belly, back, nose and tail are all pale, so a fall would stop almost at once. Nothing has improved since visit 4. About 2 minutes remain. I can't tell who placed what.

Sofia: Said the same plan at 7:00 and 7:15 (join the start row into the belly further along, gentle curve, dry run after). The repeat suggests the join wasn't done in those 15 minutes. Her direction is clear and she keeps Hana on the top bridge, but I can't verify any result. She still hasn't acknowledged that the board contradicts the earlier 'links are in'. Leadership and process are good, but execution is unproven. Ask her whether she has checked the chain herself.

Omar: Spoke for the first time with a specific, useful diagnosis. He said the chain stalls at the end of the start row because one domino sits too tight, and suggested pulling it and re-seating it. This is plausible, since the dark run ends there. That's good collaboration and analysis, but he says he is staying off it, so he is not hands-on. Still no sign of the upper fork joining. Ask what he is physically building.

Hana: Silent on the top bridge. Nothing confirmed, and the tail dry run is still unverified. Impact is unknown, so I can't rate her fairly yet. Ask her directly.

Jack: Not heard this visit. His earlier 'links are in' claim was not borne out, so execution is unverified. Check whether he is helping with the join.

Rate on what I verified. Final check: did the start-to-belly join get made, and did the dry run run?"}
